# SmallWorldNetworks

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-07-30

## Definition
A network topology characterized by high local clustering and short average path lengths between any two nodes. Small-world properties are key for iNEST systems to achieve efficient neuromorphic communication with low latency while maintaining local processing density.
